mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SEQ_NO AS msgid, CALL_TO AS phn, CALL_FROM AS smssender, SUBJECT AS smslmstit, MSG AS msg, MSG AS msgsms, TO_CHAR(REQ_TIME, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS reservedt, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS regdt, SENDER_KEY AS profile, TMPL_CD AS tmplid, BUTTON_INFO AS button, FT_IMG_URL AS imageurl, FT_IMG_PATH AS imagelink, 'P' AS pcom, ETC5 AS etc5 FROM ${msg_table} WHERE CUR_STATE = '0' AND REQ_TIME <= SYSDATE
AND MSG_TYPE = 'T' AND BIZ_TYPE = 'AT'
AND MSG_TYPE = 'T' AND BIZ_TYPE = 'AI'
AND MSG_TYPE = 'T' AND BIZ_TYPE = 'FT'
AND MSG_TYPE = 'T' AND BIZ_TYPE = 'FI'
AND MSG_TYPE = 'L'
AND MSG_TYPE = 'S'
ORDER BY SEQ_NO ASC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 200
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${log_table} SELECT * FROM ${msg_table} WHERE SEQ_NO = #{msgid}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME = UPPER(#{logTable})
mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${logTable} AS SELECT * FROM ${msgTable} WHERE 1 = 2
